critical_code_review_comments: backend/archives.py restore_archive deletes the system summary note bound to that archive_id in the target conv (line 121) — good, avoids a stale summary when raw messages come back. Note: if the conv was merged (archived_conv+merged_into), it restores into merged_into rather than the original cid, which is sensible.
backend/archives.py archive_tick guards against archiving a conv whose task is still queued/running/scheduled/assembling. Good.

backend/workspace.py chat_target: `exact` matches on sorted(persona_ids) equality — correct. `other_groups` excludes only the first exact match; if multiple identical groups existed only the first would be `group` while duplicates would still show in other_groups. Minor edge case, acceptable.

backend/workspace.py discuss_task: when `conversation_id` given but it is NOT a group (e.g. a stale private cid), still reuses it as-is and attaches task. Low-risk since UI only sends group ids from chat_target.other_groups.

backend/chat.py list_conv: unread = last_message truthy AND updated_at > read_at[user]. Private conv the user owns always has last_message empty on first open (good — no unread spam). For groups with no last_message yet, unread stays false until first assistant reply. OK.

backend/chat.py direct_conv: sort=[('updated_at',-1)] + archived_conv:$ne True — if multiple historical private convs exist for same persona, picks most recent non-archived. Good; still idempotent per iter25 cleanup.
Chat.jsx loadConvs still appends without dedup (carryover from iter25). Not re-tested but still worth fixing to eliminate duplicate React key warnings.

Archives.jsx: archive-restore inline confirm uses state local to card (confirm/busy). Correct — doesn't collide with other cards. Infinite scroll: Sentinel loads more via has_more+next_before; not stress-tested here but structure is correct.
